boy-scouts-in-the-coal-caverns-or-the-li: Part of G. Harvey Ralphson's long-running Boy Scouts series, this adventure sends a troop of young scouts into the dark passages of coal mines. Underground they face cave-ins, getting lost, and the test of keeping cool when danger strikes. Written for boys of the 1910s, the story mixes thrills with the movement's lessons in courage, teamwork, and quick thinking.
